summary.name: PixAI
summary.one_liner: PixAI is a web-based AI art generator focused on anime-style images, offering a library of anime models and LoRAs and daily free credits.
use_cases: Generating anime-style illustrations from text prompts
Creating fan art of popular anime and game characters
Exploring community anime models and LoRAs
Making quick character concept art without drawing skills
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PixAI as an online AI art generator for anime-inspired artwork: users type a prompt and receive images in seconds. It cites a library of over 1.8 million anime models and LoRAs. New sign-ups are described as receiving 10,000 starter credits, and the page mentions daily free credits. A contest section and a long list of anime and game franchise tags (such as Fate, Genshin Impact, Pokémon and Hololive) suggest the site is organized around fan-created character art.
notable: Library of 1.8M+ anime models and LoRAs, per page
10,000 starter credits on sign-up and daily free credits
Browse and generate art tagged by popular anime and game franchises
caveats: The PixAI iOS app is temporarily unavailable on the App Store according to a notice on the page
Credits are a limited resource; the page does not detail paid tier costs
